title: SvgAnimate
responsibility: Renders the native animate element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgAnimate.attributes
inputs.description: Native animate attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgAnimate.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native animate element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgAnimate
outputs.description: The actual native animate element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
